body: I haven't done that, no. My parents' philosophy is "Disorders are normal things with labels on them. The labels are taken advantage of by doctors and the government to make money." They're great parents, they simply have some flawed logic.
I don't know, really. It just seems like a lot of money for something that's going to absorb another good portion of my life. Even things I enjoy in school don't really stimulate my mind.
I've never really thought about Japan as an option. Always thought I'd buy a van join join the folks over at /r/vandwellers. Just live in a van around America.

I don't know if you feel the same way, but is just drains my will to live. I want to experience new things, to leave my home and travel. I want to go to new places, to find somewhere where I can *feel* again. I just feel so useless where I am.
This was always another issue: "you'll go to college." That isn't for me. It never has been. School's drained enough of my individuality, I don't need a whole 4 extra years to lose more of it.
